blocks.en: Understand the purpose of the Deliverable Volume test: to ensure that an oral liquid, once removed from its container, delivers the labeled volume

blocks.en: Master the calculation for Density Determination and how it is applied in volume measurement

blocks.en: Distinguish the sampling numbers and acceptance criteria for multiple-unit and single-unit containers

blocks.en: Become familiar with the two methods of measuring volume, by weight and by volume, and how each is performed

blocks.zh: 理解三階段測試策略（10 個初始 → 必要時再加 20 個）的判斷邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the decision logic of the staged test strategy (10 initial units, then 20 more if necessary)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 可遞送體積（Deliverable Volume）是口服液體製劑的基本品質屬性——患者實際從瓶中取得的量是否符合標示量。此測試的核心問題：
blocks.en: Deliverable Volume is a basic quality attribute of oral liquids: does the amount the patient actually gets from the bottle match the labeled amount? The core questions of this test are:

blocks.zh: 液體從容器轉出時，殘留在瓶壁的量是多少？
blocks.en: How much liquid remains on the container wall when it is transferred out?

blocks.zh: 如何準確測量黏稠、含懸浮粒子或容易夾帶氣泡的液體體積？
blocks.en: How can the volume of a viscous liquid, or one containing suspended particles or prone to entrained air, be measured accurately?

blocks.zh: 豁免條件：若產品是 single-unit 包裝且個別品項均一性已透過 〈905〉 測試驗證，則 〈698〉 測試不適用。
blocks.en: Exemption: if the product is packaged in single-unit containers and the uniformity of the individual units has been verified by the ⟨905⟩ test, the ⟨698⟩ test does not apply.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Density Determination
blocks.en: Density Determination: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh:
密度計算公式：
Result = W/V

W = 加入樣品的重量（g）
V = 50.0 mL − 加入水的體積（mL）

原理：
• 使用 100 mL 定量瓶，預先裝入 50.0 mL 水
• 加入約 25 g 樣品，再從滴定管補水至刻度
• V = 50.0 − （補加水量）= 樣品佔據的體積（mL）
• 密度 = 重量 ÷ 體積（g/mL）

例：加入 25.3 g 樣品，補水 24.8 mL
V = 50.0 − 24.8 = 25.2 mL
密度 = 25.3 ÷ 25.2 = 1.004 g/mL
blocks.en:
Density formula:
Result = W/V

W = weight of the sample added (g)
V = 50.0 mL − volume of water added (mL)

Principle:
• Use a 100-mL volumetric flask pre-filled with 50.0 mL of water
• Add about 25 g of sample, then top up to the mark with water from a buret
• V = 50.0 − (volume of water added) = volume occupied by the sample (mL)
• Density = weight ÷ volume (g/mL)

Example: 25.3 g of sample added, 24.8 mL of water added
V = 50.0 − 24.8 = 25.2 mL
Density = 25.3 ÷ 25.2 = 1.004 g/mL

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 為什麼用重量換算體積，而不直接量體積？想像量一杯奶昔——搖晃後滿是氣泡，直接看刻度不準確。先秤重量再換算（用密度），就像廚師先秤食材重量，比用量杯更精確。密度法消除了「空氣夾帶誤差（air entrainment error）」的問題。
blocks.en: Why convert weight to volume instead of measuring the volume directly? Imagine measuring a cup of milkshake: after shaking it is full of bubbles, so reading the scale directly is not accurate. Weighing it first and then converting (using density) is like a chef weighing ingredients, which is more precise than using a measuring cup. The density method eliminates the problem of air entrainment error.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 含流量限制器（flow restrictor）的容器（如配附口服注射器接頭的瓶子），測試時需依標籤說明排放，不能直接傾倒。這反映了實際使用情境（use conditions）的重要性。此外，非水性製劑（如含油性基劑）可使用其他密度測定方法，因為位移法對非混溶性液體不適用。
blocks.en: For containers fitted with a flow restrictor (for example, bottles with an oral syringe adapter), the test must be performed by dispensing according to the label directions rather than pouring directly. This reflects the importance of actual use conditions. In addition, non-aqueous preparations (for example, those with an oil-based vehicle) may use other methods of density determination, because the displacement method is not suitable for immiscible liquids.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼不直接用量筒測量口服混懸液的體積，而要先測密度、再由重量換算？
blocks.en: Why not measure the volume of an oral suspension directly with a graduated cylinder, instead of measuring density first and then converting from weight?

blocks.zh: 若一種口服液密度為 1.20 g/mL，取 60.0 g，計算可遞送體積為多少 mL？
blocks.en: If an oral liquid has a density of 1.20 g/mL and 60.0 g is taken, what is the deliverable volume in mL?

blocks.zh: Section 2: Test Preparations & Procedure Section 2: 試驗製備與操作程序
blocks.en: Section 2: Test Preparations & Procedure

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 測試設計邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Test Design Logic

blocks.zh: 〈698〉 採用分階段取樣策略：
blocks.en: ⟨698⟩ uses a staged sampling strategy:

blocks.zh: 總備用量：選取 NLT 30 個容器（備用第二階段用）
blocks.en: Total sample on hand: select NLT 30 containers (reserved for Stage 2)

blocks.zh: 第一階段：測試 10 個容器
blocks.en: Stage 1: test 10 containers

blocks.zh: 第二階段（如需）：再測 20 個，共 30 個
blocks.en: Stage 2 (if needed): test 20 more, for a total of 30

blocks.zh: 兩種測定方法比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of the two measurement methods:

blocks.zh: 重量法（by weight）：先秤重，再用密度換算體積；較精確，特別適合黏稠或易起泡的液體
blocks.en: By weight: weigh first, then convert to volume using density; more accurate, particularly suitable for viscous or foaming liquids

blocks.zh: 體積法（by volume）：直接用量筒測量；操作更直覺，但需確保無氣泡，量筒容量需為量測體積的 1–2.5 倍
blocks.en: By volume: measure directly with a graduated cylinder; more intuitive to perform, but you must ensure there are no air bubbles, and the cylinder capacity must be 1–2.5 times the volume to be measured

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 排放時間差異
blocks.en: Analogy: Differences in Drain Time

blocks.zh: 「排放時間」規定反映了不同容器類型的實際使用：
blocks.en: The drain-time requirements reflect how each container type is actually used:

blocks.zh: Single-unit（≤5 秒）：就像一次性小杯優格——快速傾倒，所有內容物幾乎都能取出
blocks.en: Single-unit (≤5 seconds): like a single-serve cup of yogurt, you pour it out quickly and almost all of the contents come out

blocks.zh: Multiple-unit（≤10 分鐘）：就像一瓶蜂蜜——需要時間讓黏稠液體完全流出，10 分鐘是合理的等待上限
blocks.en: Multiple-unit (≤10 minutes): like a jar of honey, a viscous liquid needs time to flow out completely, and 10 minutes is a reasonable upper limit to wait

blocks.zh: 量筒容量不超過 2.5 倍，是為了確保讀數在量筒的有效範圍內，避免在底部刻度（不精確區間）讀數。
blocks.en: The cylinder capacity is limited to no more than 2.5 times the volume so that the reading falls within the cylinder's effective range, avoiding readings in the lowest graduations (the imprecise region).

blocks.zh: 量筒規格要求：需使用「to contain（TC）」校正的量筒（而非「to deliver，TD」校正），這兩種量筒的校正基準不同——TC 量筒以容納特定體積為準，不考慮壁殘留；本測試中我們量測轉入量筒的液體體積，因此使用 TC 校正量筒。
blocks.en: Graduated cylinder requirements: use a cylinder calibrated "to contain" (TC) rather than "to deliver" (TD). The two types have different calibration bases: a TC cylinder is calibrated to hold a specified volume and does not allow for wall retention. In this test we measure the volume of liquid transferred into the cylinder, so a TC-calibrated cylinder is used.

blocks.zh: 30° 傾斜角：在沒有特定指示的情況下，容器以約 30° 角傾斜排放，這是模擬正常使用時的典型倒液姿勢，確保測試條件與使用場景一致。
blocks.en: 30° tilt angle: unless otherwise specified, the container is tilted at about 30° when dispensing. This simulates the typical pouring posture in normal use and keeps the test conditions consistent with actual use.

blocks.zh: 重組粉末製劑：需先按標籤指示加入準確量的稀釋液，充分振搖後再測試，模擬患者實際操作的完整流程。
blocks.en: Constituted powder products: first add the exact amount of diluent as directed on the label and shake thoroughly before testing, simulating the complete procedure the patient actually follows.

blocks.zh: 測試一款 100 mL 的口服混懸液，應使用哪個規格的量筒（最大量程）？排放時間上限是多少？
blocks.en: For testing a 100-mL oral suspension, which size of graduated cylinder (maximum capacity) should be used? What is the upper limit for drain time?

blocks.zh: 某兒科口服液在搖晃後有大量氣泡，測試時氣泡未消散就讀數。這對結果有何影響？應如何處理？
blocks.en: A pediatric oral liquid forms a lot of bubbles after shaking, and the reading is taken before the bubbles have dissipated. How does this affect the result, and how should it be handled?

blocks.zh: Section 3: Acceptance Criteria Section 3: 允收標準
blocks.en: Section 3: Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 判斷流程
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: Decision Flow

blocks.zh:
Multiple-unit 容器（10 個）：
通過：平均 ≥100% 且全部 ≥95%
→ 進入 Stage 2（A 或 B）：
  A: 平均 <100% 但全部 ≥95%
  B: 平均 ≥100% 但有 1 個 90%–95%
失敗：
  - 平均 <100% 且有任一個 <95%（直接失敗）
  - 有任一個 <90%（直接失敗）

Single-unit 容器（10 個）：
通過：平均 ≥100% 且全部在 95%–110%
→ 進入 Stage 2（A 或 B）：
  A: 平均 <100% 但全部在 95%–110%
  B: 平均 ≥100% 但有 1 個在 90%–115%
失敗：
  - 有任一個在 90%–95% 或 110%–115% 外（直接失敗情況）
  - 有任一個 <90% 或 >115%（直接失敗）
blocks.en:
Multiple-unit containers (10 units):
Pass: average ≥100% and all ≥95%
→ Proceed to Stage 2 (A or B):
  A: average <100% but all ≥95%
  B: average ≥100% but 1 unit is 90%–95%
Fail:
  - average <100% and any unit <95% (immediate failure)
  - any unit <90% (immediate failure)

Single-unit containers (10 units):
Pass: average ≥100% and all within 95%–110%
→ Proceed to Stage 2 (A or B):
  A: average <100% but all within 95%–110%
  B: average ≥100% but 1 unit is within 90%–115%
Fail:
  - any unit outside 90%–95% or 110%–115% (immediate failure case)
  - any unit <90% or >115% (immediate failure)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 為什麼 Single-unit 有上限 110%？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Does a Single-unit Container Have a 110% Upper Limit?

blocks.zh: 多劑量容器（如一瓶糖漿）標示 100 mL，給的稍多無妨——患者按指示取用即可。但單劑量容器（如一個預裝注射器）標示 5 mL，若給了 6 mL（120%），患者可能直接全部注射，導致過量。因此 Single-unit 容器必須嚴格控制上限（≤110%）。
blocks.en: A multiple-unit container (such as a bottle of syrup) labeled 100 mL can contain a little extra without harm, because the patient simply takes the dose as directed. But a single-unit container (such as a prefilled syringe) labeled 5 mL that delivers 6 mL (120%) may lead the patient to inject all of it, resulting in an overdose. Single-unit containers therefore require a strictly controlled upper limit (≤110%).

blocks.zh: 下限的考量則相反：給的太少（<90%），患者可能實際接受的劑量不足，影響療效。
blocks.en: The lower limit is considered from the opposite angle: if too little is delivered (<90%), the patient may actually receive an insufficient dose, compromising efficacy.

blocks.zh: 「平均 ≥100%」的核心意義：這確保了整體批次不存在系統性短量，若平均值低於 100%，代表充填工藝可能有問題，即使個別差異還在允許範圍內也需要調查。
blocks.en: The core meaning of "average ≥100%": this ensures that the batch as a whole does not have a systematic underfill. If the average is below 100%, the filling process may have a problem, and an investigation is needed even if the individual differences are still within the permitted range.

blocks.zh: 充填量設定的實務考量：生產時通常設定充填量略高於標示量（例如標示 100 mL，充填目標 102 mL），以確保在考量製程變異後，實際遞送量仍能符合 ≥100% 的要求。
blocks.en: Practical considerations in setting the fill volume: in production, the fill volume is usually set slightly above the labeled amount (for example, a 100-mL label with a fill target of 102 mL), so that after process variability is taken into account, the delivered volume still meets the ≥100% requirement.

blocks.zh: 某 Multiple-unit 口服液（標示 120 mL）測試 10 個容器，結果：平均 121 mL（≈100.8%），其中 1 個容器為 113 mL（≈94.2%）。判斷：通過、進入第二階段，還是直接不合格？
blocks.en: A multiple-unit oral liquid (labeled 120 mL) is tested on 10 containers. Results: average 121 mL (≈100.8%), with 1 container at 113 mL (≈94.2%). Determine: pass, proceed to Stage 2, or fail outright?

blocks.zh: 某 Single-unit 口服液（標示 5 mL）測試 10 個容器，平均 5.05 mL（101%），但有 2 個容器分別為 4.6 mL 和 5.6 mL。判斷結果如何？
blocks.en: A single-unit oral liquid (labeled 5 mL) is tested on 10 containers. The average is 5.05 mL (101%), but 2 containers measure 4.6 mL and 5.6 mL respectively. What is the outcome?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 Fill-Finish 生產線上，可遞送體積測試結果直接關聯到充填機的調校（fill volume adjustment）。若初步測試顯示 Stage 2 情況，QA 應啟動調查，確認是充填設備問題（如泵壓不穩定、針頭磨損）還是產品本身的黏度變化。這也是過程能力（Process Capability, Cpk）評估的核心指標之一。
blocks.en: On a fill-finish line, deliverable volume results are directly linked to fill volume adjustment of the filling machine. If initial testing leads to a Stage 2 situation, QA should start an investigation to confirm whether the cause is the filling equipment (for example, unstable pump pressure or worn needles) or a change in the viscosity of the product itself. This is also one of the core indicators for process capability (Cpk) assessment.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 測試目的：確保口服液體製劑從容器轉出後，能遞送標示體積；適用於傾倒分配型液體製劑（含重組粉末製劑）
blocks.en: Test purpose: to ensure that an oral liquid delivers the labeled volume after being transferred out of its container; applies to liquid preparations dispensed by pouring (including constituted powder products)

blocks.zh: 豁免條件：Single-unit 容器且已進行 〈905〉 Uniformity of Dosage Units 測試，則無需 〈698〉 測試
blocks.en: Exemption: for single-unit containers that have been tested under ⟨905⟩ Uniformity of Dosage Units, the ⟨698⟩ test is not required

blocks.zh: 密度測定：Density = W/V（W=樣品重量，V=50.0 mL − 補水量），用於重量法換算體積，消除氣泡夾帶誤差
blocks.en: Density determination: Density = W/V (W = sample weight, V = 50.0 mL − volume of water added), used in the by-weight method to convert weight to volume and eliminate air entrainment error

blocks.zh: 測試方法：重量法（秤重 → 換算）或體積法（量筒直接測量，30° 傾斜，量筒容量 ≤2.5×目標體積，無氣泡後讀數）
blocks.en: Test methods: by weight (weigh, then convert) or by volume (measure directly in a graduated cylinder, 30° tilt, cylinder capacity ≤2.5× the target volume, read once bubbles have cleared)

blocks.zh: 排放時間：Single-unit ≤5 秒；Multiple-unit ≤10 分鐘
blocks.en: Drain time: single-unit ≤5 seconds; multiple-unit ≤10 minutes

blocks.zh: Multiple-unit 接受標準：平均 ≥100%，每個 ≥95%；第二階段（30 個）：平均 ≥100%，最多 1 個 ≥90%
blocks.en: Multiple-unit acceptance criteria: average ≥100%, each unit ≥95%; Stage 2 (30 units): average ≥100%, at most 1 unit ≥90%

blocks.zh: Single-unit 接受標準：平均 ≥100%，每個 95%–110%；第二階段（30 個）：平均 ≥100%，最多 1 個 90%–115%
blocks.en: Single-unit acceptance criteria: average ≥100%, each unit 95%–110%; Stage 2 (30 units): average ≥100%, at most 1 unit 90%–115%

blocks.zh: 生產意義：充填目標通常設定略高於標示量，以應對製程變異並確保遞送量 ≥100%
blocks.en: Production significance: the fill target is usually set slightly above the labeled amount to accommodate process variability and ensure a delivered volume of ≥100%
